record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, shorten only the causal pooling half-life from three interactions to 2.5, retaining the incumbent 0.8*h_t+0.2*m_t blend. Since half-life three improved over four while reducing the pooled contribution regressed, modestly faster decay may sharpen recent interests while preserving pooling strength. Exclude padding and future states, retain final-real-position inference, and synchronize checkpoint metadata and the predictor writer. Keep all other settings fixed.
